dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hello? Oh, hi. I have a problem, I ordered a pizza and it's too damn spicy...
{WRONG NUMBER}Are you sure you've reached the right number?
{EXCUSE ME?}Excuse me?
Daaaaamn sure.
My pizza. It's extremely spicy. I could barely manage to eat a slice.
{ARE YOU IN DANGER?} Sir, are you in danger, but you can't talk about it because of someone in the room?
What? Nah! I just want to get my money back!
{ARE YOU KIDDING?} Is this a joke?
Yo, do I sound like I'm joking? Pizza is neeeeever a joke.
{ARE YOU HIGH?} Are you high?

dialogOption.emotions: lazy, a bit nostalgic and sad
dialogOption.texten: High as a kite. And I want my munchies. It's tough, man.
{DON'T BLOCK THE LINE}Please don't occupy the line unnecessarily.
{HANG UP}
{CALL THE PIZZA PLACE} This isn't a matter for police. Please call the pizza place and complain to them.
{DON'T WASTE MY TIME} Man, don't waste my time!
Think, how would you feel if it was your pizza... Ughhh... I'm disappointed, dude. May your pizza never be too spicy. Peace.
I tried, yo, but they told me to fuck off. It was very rude. Can some officer come and help me?
{CAN'T HELP YOU}Sir, we can't help you.
Ughhhh... that was hot.

reportElement.texten: The caller was under influence of drugs. He hadn't got any emergency situation and he was occupying the line unnecessarily
The operator lose his patience during the conversation.
